<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="send" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A06AF9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#200E32" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8F9F7"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="116" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="25" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">9:41</text>
  <line x1="318" y1="20" x2="323" y2="20" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="318" y1="23" x2="326" y2="23" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="318" y1="26" x2="329" y2="26" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="353" y="17" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="375" y="20" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#200E32"/>
  <rect x="356" y="20" width="13" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#200E32"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <polyline points="29,68 21,76 29,84" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="76" r="21" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
  <text x="58" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">ML</text>
  <text x="91" y="70" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#200E32">Chat Courier</text>
  <text x="91" y="91" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#434343">Maya Lewis · Online</text>
  <circle cx="359" cy="76" r="4" fill="#97DAA4"/>
  <line x1="352" y1="62" x2="352" y2="90" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#200E32"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="76" r="1.5" fill="#200E32"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="90" r="1.5" fill="#200E32"/>

  <!-- conversation context -->
  <rect x="22" y="132" width="346" height="47" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="155" r="13" fill="#B4DDDD"/>
  <polygon points="39,161 44,151 49,161" fill="#6EA95C"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="151" r="2.5" fill="#FFDD72"/>
  <text x="66" y="151" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Delivery #KH-2846</text>
  <text x="66" y="168" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Market Street · Arriving today</text>
  <rect x="293" y="145" width="58" height="21" rx="10.5" fill="#A5F59C"/>
  <text x="322" y="159" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">ON WAY</text>

  <!-- date chip -->
  <rect x="158" y="193" width="74" height="24" rx="12" fill="#E7E7E7"/>
  <text x="195" y="209" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">TODAY</text>

  <!-- incoming message 1 -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="252" r="16" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
  <text x="29" y="257" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">ML</text>
  <rect x="54" y="227" width="246" height="56" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="70" y="249" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#200E32">Hi Alex! I’m on my way with your</text>
  <text x="70" y="268" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#200E32">order. I’ll be there shortly.</text>
  <text x="268" y="300" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">10:02 AM</text>

  <!-- outgoing message 1 -->
  <rect x="136" y="318" width="232" height="50" rx="17" fill="#200E32"/>
  <text x="153" y="340" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Great, thank you! Please leave it</text>
  <text x="153" y="359" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">by the front door.</text>
  <text x="303" y="385" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">10:04 AM</text>
  <polyline points="344,390 348,394 355,386" fill="none" stroke="#97DAA4" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- incoming message 2 -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="425" r="16" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
  <text x="29" y="430" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">ML</text>
  <rect x="54" y="400" width="254" height="57" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="70" y="422" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#200E32">Absolutely. Is there a safe place</text>
  <text x="70" y="441" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#200E32">you’d prefer me to put it?</text>
  <text x="274" y="474" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">10:05 AM</text>

  <!-- outgoing message 2 -->
  <rect x="180" y="492" width="188" height="48" rx="17" fill="#200E32"/>
  <text x="198" y="513" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Under the small bench</text>
  <text x="198" y="532" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">beside the door, please.</text>
  <text x="303" y="556" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">10:06 AM</text>
  <polyline points="344,561 348,565 355,557" fill="none" stroke="#97DAA4" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- incoming message 3 -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="604" r="16" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
  <text x="29" y="609" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">ML</text>
  <rect x="54" y="579" width="267" height="57" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="70" y="601" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#200E32">Got it — I’ll send you a message</text>
  <text x="70" y="620" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#200E32">once it’s been delivered. 😊</text>
  <text x="287" y="653" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">10:07 AM</text>

  <!-- typing indicator -->
  <rect x="54" y="671" width="72" height="35" rx="17" fill="#E7E7E7"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="688" r="3" fill="#5E6272"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="688" r="3" fill="#5E6272"/>
  <circle cx="102" cy="688" r="3" fill="#5E6272"/>

  <!-- composer -->
  <line x1="22" y1="719" x2="368" y2="719" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="753" r="15" fill="#E7E7E7"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="753" x2="44" y2="753" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="748" x2="39" y2="758" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <rect x="62" y="730" width="245" height="46" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="84" y="758" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#828282">Write a message...</text>
  <circle cx="286" cy="753" r="15" fill="#F8F9F7"/>
  <circle cx="282" cy="749" r="2" fill="#200E32"/>
  <circle cx="290" cy="749" r="2" fill="#200E32"/>
  <polyline points="278,755 286,761 294,755" fill="none" stroke="#200E32" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="318" y="730" width="50" height="46" rx="23" fill="url(#send)"/>
    <polygon points="335,752 354,744 347,762 343,756" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="756" x2="354" y2="744" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="798" width="390" height="46" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="798" x2="390" y2="798" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,815 47,808 56,815 56,825 50,825 50,819 44,819 44,825 38,825" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <text x="47" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="112" y="809" width="18" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="116" y1="813" x2="126" y2="813" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="116" y1="817" x2="123" y2="817" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="121" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Tasks</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="816" r="12" fill="#200E32"/>
    <polyline points="188,813 188,821 194,821 198,825 198,821 202,821 202,813" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Chat</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="273" cy="813" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="273" cy="825" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="273" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Teams</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="344" cy="813" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <path d="M334 827 C335 819 353 819 354 827" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="344" y="840" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
